defect: The fix only reformats the empty constructor body from {} to a two-line brace (clang-format style).
reason: The change compiles and behaves correctly; the later edit is pure formatting.

defect: The new GetDataOwnership only flushes the append state but never unpins the KEEP_EVERYTHING_PINNED partitioned data before handing it off, so the transferred data stays pinned in memory and cannot be spilled.
reason: The fix replaces the bare FlushAppendState in GetDataOwnership, a function this change added, with UnpinData (flush plus Unpin), matching what Finalize already did; the other edits in this file are refactors.

defect: The fix reorders AddChunk after the capacity check, fixes uncombined_data[1] to [i] and renames source-state fields; this change only dropped the append_state argument from AddChunk calls.
reason: The AddChunk ordering and the index bug predate this change (the index bug came from the earlier refactor), so nothing repaired lies in lines it introduced.

defect: The Windows ListFiles definition repeats the default argument FileOpener *opener = nullptr already given in the header declaration, which is ill-formed and fails to compile with MSVC.
reason: The fix removes exactly the default argument this change added to the out-of-line Windows definition.

defect: The fix renames VectorData/Orrify to UnifiedVectorFormat/ToUnifiedFormat to resolve a merge with an upstream API rename.
reason: The code was valid against the API at the time of the change; the fix adapts it to a later rename brought in by a merge.

defect: The new inline virtual GetStatistics returns unique_ptr<BaseStatistics> in a header where BaseStatistics is only forward-declared, so translation units without base_statistics.hpp fail to compile in the single-file build.
reason: The fix moves GetStatistics out of line into base_file_reader.cpp together with an include of base_statistics.hpp, repairing the single-file compilation break caused by the inline body this change added.

defect: The fix removes a TODO comment and a (void)mode statement that silenced an unused-variable warning.
reason: mode is used afterwards anyway, so the removed lines were harmless cleanup, not a defect.

defect: The fix inlines CreateSpillChunk and renames parameters; the actual slicing bug (lhs_output referenced before the probe chunk is sliced) is in physical_hash_join.cpp and predates this change.
reason: The CreateSpillChunk written by this change (Reset, Reference payload, add hashes) is equivalent to the fixed code, so the repaired defect is not in its lines.

defect: In this header the fix only renames the ProbeAndSpill parameters keys/payload to probe_keys/probe_chunk.
reason: The signature this change introduced is not defective; the parameter rename is cosmetic.

defect: The new HUGEINT fetch passes a const char* from c_str() to PyLong_FromString, whose Python 2 signature takes a non-const char*, breaking the build against Python 2.
reason: The fix adds a (char*) cast on exactly the PyLong_FromString call this change added, to restore compilation on Python 2.

defect: The fix renames the instantiation unique_ptr<JoinRelation> to unique_ptr<SingleJoinRelation> because a later commit added a relation-API class also named JoinRelation, which clashes in the amalgamation.
reason: When this change wrote unique_ptr<JoinRelation> it referred unambiguously to the renamed optimizer class; the name clash was introduced later by cd5129b.

defect: This commit adds a relation-API class duckdb::JoinRelation that clashes with the optimizer struct duckdb::JoinRelation, which its new EXPRESSION_GET branch also uses, breaking the amalgamation (single translation unit) build.
reason: The fix renames the optimizer class to SingleJoinRelation in all uses, including the make_unique<JoinRelation> line this change added, repairing the clash this commit created.

defect: The fix changes rename-conflict detection and drop mapping handling in catalog_set.cpp for dependent objects.
reason: The change was only clang-format line wrapping; the repaired logic was already present before it.

defect: The fix dispatches the DELTA_BINARY_PACKED decode on the Parquet physical type instead of the DuckDB internal type, so small decimals (internal INT16, stored INT32) decode instead of throwing.
reason: Before this change the switch on LogicalTypeId also threw for every DECIMAL, so the small-decimal failure was already present; the change only extended DBP support to INT32/INT64-backed types.

defect: The fix removes the bind-time assertion that the second argument is a LIST, which fired for inputs such as a VARCHAR selection argument that should give a conversion error.
reason: The parent already asserted LIST for arguments[1]; this change only relaxed the assertion to also allow SQLNULL, so the faulty assertion predates it.

defect: The fix adds the missing named_param_map entry to statement.json and regenerates the serializer, changing the property name from param_map to named_param_map.
reason: The hand-written field round-trips correctly (same field id 101); the fix brings the code-generation spec in line, a codegen consistency change rather than a functional defect.

defect: Making TIMESTAMP_SEC to TIMESTAMP invertible lets comparison simplification rewrite CAST(ts_s AS TIMESTAMP) = constant into ts_s = CAST(constant AS TIMESTAMP_S), because the reverse narrowing cast still falls through to return true, so sub-second constants truncate and compare equal (wrong results).
reason: Before this change the first CastIsInvertible check returned false and blocked the rewrite; the fix ranks timestamp precisions so the narrowing direction is not invertible, repairing the wrong comparisons this line enabled.

defect: The fix switches CheckPath, len and lens from size_t to idx_t for type consistency.
reason: The size_t signature predates this change (it only moved the static CheckPath into the class), and all callers consistently used size_t, so nothing it introduced was broken.

defect: The fix checks the arrow Status results with REQUIRE and drops an unused variable in a test file to silence warnings.
reason: This is a test-only warning cleanup, not a repair of a product defect.

defect: The fix skips the range-request fallback when HEAD returns 404 and reports res->http_url in the error, to restore download_config.test.
reason: The range-request fallback on any non-200 HEAD predates this change; the change's own bugs (inverted null check, missing throw) were fixed by intermediate commits, not by this fix.

defect: The fix reorders the create_database call arguments to match a signature changed upstream (storage_info first) and brought in by a merge.
reason: The call matched the typedef at the time of the change; the fix only adapts to a later merged API change.

defect: The fix removes an unused local variable config from Binder::Bind(DetachStatement).
reason: An unused local is a warning cleanup, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix reorders the drop_database call arguments to match an upstream signature change and adds an include.
reason: The call matched the drop_database_t typedef when this change was written; the fix adapts to a later merged API change.

defect: The new LeftRightOptimizations swaps the children of ANY_JOINs regardless of join type (breaking LEFT any-joins) and flips LEFT comparison joins to RIGHT even when a right_projection_map exists, which is then not swapped.
reason: The fix restricts the LEFT-to-RIGHT flip to empty right projection maps and handles ANY_JOIN by join type, all in code this change added.

defect: The rewritten pass-through loop uses while (OperatorNeedsRelation(op->type)) where the original condition meant the opposite, so it walks through projections and gets and stops at operators it should pass.
reason: The fix adds exactly the missing negation to the loop condition this change wrote.

defect: The fix merges a clang-format-split string literal and lowercases the CYCLES_PER_TUPLE JSON key to match the other keys.
reason: The uppercase key existed before this format-fix change, which only re-indented and split the literal without changing its text.

defect: In the new AddColumnIds the parameter column_ids shadows the member, so column_ids = std::move(column_ids) self-assigns the parameter and never sets the member.
reason: The fix changes the assignment to this->column_ids in the method this change added.

defect: The fix adds statistics_extended(nullptr) to the TableFunction constructor initializer lists.
reason: statistics_extended was added by a later commit (89e1a1b), so its missing initialization was not introduced by this change.

defect: HandleStructExtract computes the extracted field type by walking indexes from front to back, but the recursion stores the outermost extract first, so nested struct extracts get the wrong field type or index into the wrong struct children.
reason: The fix reverses the walk (indexes.back() first, then indexes[size-1-i]) in the type computation this change added.

defect: The new Slice/SliceInPlace API reads at target_offset and writes at source_offset (roles swapped), and its Vector::Slice callers pass end instead of end - offset as count, so the mask is oversized and the source validity is read past its end.
reason: The fix redefines Slice as (source_offset, count), corrects the SliceInPlace read/write offsets and makes callers pass end - offset, repairing the API this change introduced.

defect: The fix restores reporting segment_state->GetSegmentInfo() (overflow string info) in storage_info.
reason: That reporting was dropped by the parent commit ad876b5, not by this change, which only converted the segment-info map to a string.

defect: The fix moves the UNION-semantics check into the set-operation case and makes a WITH RECURSIVE CTE without a set operation fall back to a regular select.
reason: Before this change such non-setop recursive CTEs already threw (NotImplemented in the default case); the change only altered which error was thrown.

defect: The change calls the new Utf8Proc::Normalize(const char*, size_t), which returns a malloc'ed char*, and converts it straight into a std::string without freeing it, leaking memory for each non-ASCII string.
reason: The fix stores the returned pointer, adds it to the result and frees it, repairing the leak introduced by the call this change added.

defect: The fix converts DECIMAL values in the C API with their width and scale (TryCastFromDecimal, StringCastFromDecimal) instead of casting the unscaled integer.
reason: Before the change, decimals were cast from the raw unscaled hugeint and were already wrong; this change was an incomplete attempt that the fix finishes.

defect: The fix copies the input lists into the result before sorting so list_sort no longer reorders the input column's child vector in place.
reason: This WIP change sorted a separate ChunkCollection and never touched the input; the in-place sort of the input child vector came from later commits.

defect: The new lock_configuration check rejects every RESET, including schema and search_path, so locking the configuration also breaks schema switching (USE and RESET schema).
reason: The fix replaces the blanket check this change added with DBConfig::CheckLock, which exempts schema and search_path, repairing the breakage reported in issue 8624.

defect: The fix stops warning when the cross-join ref type is already CROSS and rewords the warning message.
reason: The warning and its condition were added by a later commit (c6b8309); this change did not emit any warning.

defect: The fix makes VariantStats::Merge also merge shredded child statistics instead of asserting that neither side is shredded.
reason: Before the change Merge already ignored shredded stats; the change only made that assumption an explicit assertion, so the missing shredded merge predates it.

defect: duckdb_string_t_data takes duckdb_string_t by value and returns a pointer to its data, which for inlined short strings points into the callee's copy and dangles after return.
reason: The fix changes the declaration this change added to take duckdb_string_t *, so the returned pointer refers to the caller's string.

defect: The fix replaces the stack LocalFileSystem with FileSystem::CreateLocal(), makes the paths const and drops an unused include.
reason: This is a refactor; the real defect of the change (the removed file_writer.Flush, so buffered secret data is never written) is left unrepaired and was fixed later in 19bbb65.
